name: Blacephalon
description: Blacephalon, the Fireworks Pokémon. A Fire and Ghost type.
pokedex_entries: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents' surprise to rob them of their vitality.
